shows: The whole application on the demo project: menus, toolbars, Project Manager, Book1 and Graph1 in the workspace, Object Manager, console bar and status bar.
The Project Manager panel: the demo project tree with workbooks, graphs and folders.
The Object Manager panel for Graph1: its layer, series and curve with their check boxes.
The Spectrum sheet of Book1 with the header rows (Long Name, Units, Comments, F(x)=, Metadata), the column letters and roles, and the sheet tabs.
The context menu of a column header (right-click on B(Y)): Plot, Add Column, Analysis, clipboard, Move, Type, Role, Reset Width, Clear, Delete.
The Formula Functions window opened by the ? of the F(x)= cell, on the Column values family: the families as vertical tabs at the left, the table Function, Example, What it does at the right.
The Series Properties window of Graph1: series list, group, name, plot type, Y axis, Y error and X error, line and symbol settings.

The Graph Properties window on its General tab for a graph with two layers side by side: title, colors, and the Size section with the plot area width of each column, the plot area height of the row, the distance from the left and top edges of the graph to the first plot area (Left stored, Top Auto) and the size of the graph in centimeters (two fields, width and height, with a padlock beside them), then the Advanced block opened on Figure size. The Size section also shows the Layer placement choice (Regular grid selected).
The Graph Properties window on its Axes tab, Bottom axis: the axes as vertical tabs at the left, then title, scale, range and display settings.
The Graph Properties window on its Axes tab for an overlay layer (Layer 2): Top tab selected with Own scale and Show axis, Bottom and Left grayed out.

The Graph Properties window on its Legend tab for a graph with a two-column legend: Show legend, Position, Text from, then the Text section (Font, Font size, Text color), the Frame section (Show frame, Frame color red, Frame width 2 pt, Background white at 50 % opacity) and the Layout section (Columns 2, row and column gaps, Line sample length 40 pt).

The Graph Properties window on its Legend tab, scrolled to the open Color bar section: Show color bar ticked, the series group Kinetics with its On the bar box ticked and its folded Ranges, Chain the segments, the value, scale, placement, ticks and title settings.
The Annotations demo graph: text annotations written with formulas (subscripts, Greek letters), a rectangle, an ellipse and an arrow.
Graph1 with two cells side by side: the numbered layer badges 1 and 2 sit at the top left of their own cells, badge 1 highlighted as the active layer.

Graph1 with two layers side by side in the Page Layout Mode on a regular grid: rulers along the top and left edges, the grid, the selected graph with its handles, the four corners of the figure, and the settings strip under the figure (Figure size, Graph 1 with X Y W H, Align, Same Size, Distribute, Snap with Coarse | Fine, Grid mode with Regular | Free, When axes are added with Grows with the axes | Fixed).
The Integrate analysis window on Graph1 with one range from 470 to 570 nm, its shaded preview and the computed area.
The Fitting analysis window on Graph1: Gaussian model fitted on the main peak (490 to 550 nm), parameters, residuals and R squared.
The Preferences window, General page with the rubrics across the top: language, maximum file size and cells, automatic recovery copy, analysis defaults.
The Preferences window, Export page: SVG text, PNG resolution and the formats offered together by Copy Graph, in order.
The Preferences window, Display rubric, Object Manager tab (vertical sub-tabs at the left): the lists and the groups expanded by default.
The Preferences window, Display rubric, New tab (vertical sub-tabs at the left): the header rows of new workbooks and the decimal comma of new graphs.
The Preferences window, Folders rubric: the configuration folder with its files, the recovery copies and the default folders of the file dialogs.
The Recover Projects window listing two recovery copies with Open, Ignore and Delete.
The Graph menu open, with Graph1 in the foreground.
The Graph Properties window, Axes tab, Bottom axis with Log scale ticked, the axes as vertical tabs at the left.
The Correction analysis window on Graph1: polynomial baseline on two background zones.

A JASCO UV file (test/import) in the Import window: the file tab, the recognised line, the format, the offer to save the settings, What was found at the left; the file as a grid with line numbers, key;value roles, auto tags, data handles and the minimap at the right; the You get line and the footer menus.

A synthetic JASCO kinetic in the Import window: the orange frame with 2 points to check, a Mark as Checked button beside each sentence, Check Now, and the To check tags with their check marks in the rows of What was found.
The Import window on the kinetic with the correction window of the Data row open (First data line, Last data line) under the row.
The Save as Template window over the import: the name, Used for files that with the conditions found in the file and their check boxes, Your conditions with Add condition, and What it sets.
The Import Templates window: a saved template with its conditions, what it sets and Forget Template, and Answers remembered with the answers given for a kind of file, each with Forget.
A plain two-column CSV in the Import window with the Advanced fold open: date order, leading characters, blocks, missing values, comment prefix and skipped data lines.
The Object Manager for Graph1 with the series selected.
The Peak Decomposition window on Graph1: Gaussian peaks with a constant background detected on the spectrum, the preview with the fitted curve and the values of each peak.
The transposed sheet of Kinetics in Book1: the banner Transposed from Kinetics with the box Recalculate automatically checked, the x' column and one column per row analysed.
The Workbook menu of the menu bar, opened on Book1.

The Import from Origin window opened on a small synthetic Origin project: the file name, its workbooks with their check boxes (a dash when only some sheets are checked) and short names, each sheet with its number of columns and rows, the line "To create: ... sheets in ... workbooks" under the list, and the footer Check All, Check None, Cancel and Import.

The Python Script console after running a short script that finds the maximum of the Spectrum sheet: the script in the text box, the Run and Stop buttons and the output area. Rendered only by a build with the python feature.
